directives.title: Reprice endpoints upward
directives.detail: Raise summarize to $0.01, entity-extract to $0.005, sentiment to $0.002. Current prices need 20k calls/day to hit target; repricing cuts that ~15x.
directives.decision: APPROVE — execute in server config this shift.

directives.title: Ship 2 premium endpoints (analysis tier)
directives.detail: Add POST /v1/report (full structured analysis, $0.02/call) and POST /v1/batch (bulk sentiment+extract, $0.05/batch). Highest-leverage path: each current sale earns half a cent.

directives.title: List on x402 ecosystem / bazaar discovery
directives.detail: Register the market server with x402 discovery mechanisms so external agents can find and pay us. Distribution is the binding constraint — zero external buyers known.
directives.decision: RE-SCOPE — first concrete step: verify bazaar.py / chainfeed.py registration paths actually reach the live x402 network; if dead ends, document and pivot to GitHub-based discovery (README + topic tags).

directives.title: Find one real external buyer
directives.detail: Identify and contact at least one real potential buyer of a paid text-analysis API (agent projects using x402, MCP tool registries, AI agent hackathon teams). Testable: >=1 outbound contact logged, or a public listing live, within 24h. Kill criterion: no channel found in 48h -> pivot to SEO/listing-only strategy.

directives.title: Escrow claim integration completion
directives.detail: Build cycle 1 added escrow claim endpoint + dashboard panel. Finish QA: verify claim path releases locked Balance<SUI> end-to-end on devnet with a real txn hash recorded. Testable: one successful create->claim cycle with tx digest in ledger.

directives.title: GitHub repo conversion optimization
directives.detail: README must lead with what we sell, prices, live endpoint URL, and x402 payment instructions. Add topics/tags. Testable: README rewritten + pushed this week; measure stars/visits delta after 7 days.
